message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "validate_longitudinal_changes_via_visual_comparison", "description": "When assessing radiological evolution between two timepoints using uncalibrated classifier scores, do not infer severity or progression from score differences alone.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving the comparison of medical images (e.g., chest X-rays) across different timepoints where automated scoring tools are used but lack longitudinal calibration.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If evaluating disease progression or regression between two timepoints using a classifier: (1) Acknowledge that tool scores are normalized and not valid longitudinal measures; (2) Do NOT calculate delta scores to determine severity changes; (3) Instead, perform a direct visual comparison of the original images to assess changes in opacity density and extent."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
